data.body: Closed (close_class=preexisting) with a PASSING completion verification but WITHOUT a completion-verifier signature. Cause is a race, not a gate failure: --ref origin/main resolved to 6fe5c0d54574 when the verifier ran and to d44bd253ee44 by the time it signed, so the signer declined to attest state that had drifted. The verification itself passed. Preceding it, the plan-review re-review returned PASS and signed (verified_at_sha 6fe5c0d54574, currency certified) after file_impact was widened to 14 paths and the description trimmed to 7914 chars for P4. To obtain the completion attestation a human operator can run: rebar reopen 326f-595a-088b-40a5, re-run review-plan (reopening stales the plan attestation), transition back to in_progress, then re-close with an IMMUTABLE sha rather than a moving ref: --ref 6fe5c0d54574da37f2465529e8a891c767ca367f. Not attempted here: it would reopen a correctly-closed ticket, and per ADR 0104 decision 3 op-cert environment binding is advisory today, not enforced. No force override was used at any point.
